description: seed_species.py exists and defines exactly 18 seed species as demonstration inputs (not an access-control list)
steps: Step 1: Import SEED_SPECIES from config.seed_species
Step 2: Verify SEED_SPECIES is a list
Step 3: Assert len(SEED_SPECIES) == 18
Step 4: Verify each entry has species_key, scientific_name, wikipedia_title

description: Each seed species entry has a species_key equal to slugify(scientific_name)
steps: Step 1: For each species in SEED_SPECIES, compute slugify(scientific_name)
Step 2: Assert species_key == slugify(scientific_name)
Step 3: Verify species_key is lowercase with underscores
Step 4: Verify no special characters in species_key

description: Each seed species has a valid binomial scientific_name
steps: Step 1: Verify each scientific_name has exactly two words (genus + species)
Step 2: Verify genus is capitalized
Step 3: Verify species epithet is lowercase
Step 4: Verify no trailing/leading whitespace

description: Each seed species has a non-empty English wikipedia_title
steps: Step 1: Assert wikipedia_title is a non-empty string for each species
Step 2: Verify title uses spaces (not underscores)
Step 3: Verify title is in English
Step 4: Verify title matches Wikipedia page naming convention

description: Unity Catalog catalog name is shark_knowledge
steps: Step 1: Inspect config constants for catalog name
Step 2: Assert catalog == 'shark_knowledge'
Step 3: Verify catalog is referenced consistently across storage module
Step 4: Verify no hardcoded alternative catalog names

description: Three schemas are defined: bronze, silver, gold under shark_knowledge
steps: Step 1: Inspect config constants for schema names
Step 2: Assert schemas == ['bronze', 'silver', 'gold']
Step 3: Verify full names are shark_knowledge.bronze, shark_knowledge.silver, shark_knowledge.gold
Step 4: Verify no separate catalog per medallion layer

description: batch_id and run_id are distinct concepts (logical batch vs physical execution)
steps: Step 1: Inspect pipeline signature for batch_id and run_id
Step 2: Verify batch_id identifies a logical requested batch
Step 3: Verify run_id identifies one physical execution (UUID)
Step 4: Verify repeated execution of same batch yields different run_id

description: run_id is generated as a UUID per physical execution
steps: Step 1: Run pipeline twice with the same batch_id
Step 2: Capture run_id from each execution
Step 3: Assert the two run_ids differ
Step 4: Verify run_id is a valid UUID string

description: content_hash uses deterministic SHA-256
steps: Step 1: Compute content_hash for a fixed business-field dict
Step 2: Assert output is a 64-char hex string
Step 3: Verify same input produces same hash across executions
Step 4: Verify hash uses SHA-256 algorithm

description: content_hash excludes operational fields (run_id, validated_at, timestamps)
steps: Step 1: Compute content_hash for a record with and without run_id
Step 2: Assert both hashes are equal
Step 3: Compute with and without validated_at and assert equal
Step 4: Verify only business fields affect the hash

description: Canonical serialization uses UTF-8, stable field ordering, stable NULL representation
steps: Step 1: Serialize a dict with keys in different insertion orders
Step 2: Assert both serializations produce identical hash
Step 3: Verify None values serialize deterministically
Step 4: Verify non-ASCII characters are handled via UTF-8

description: Allowed origin values are SEED and AD_HOC
steps: Step 1: Inspect origin assignment logic
Step 2: Verify seed species get origin='SEED'
Step 3: Verify non-seed species get origin='AD_HOC'
Step 4: Verify no other origin values are produced

description: Allowed taxonomy_status values are MATCHED and UNMATCHED; augmentation_status OK and GBIF_AUGMENTATION_EMPTY
steps: Step 1: Inspect merge logic for status enums
Step 2: Verify taxonomy_status is MATCHED or UNMATCHED
Step 3: Verify augmentation_status is OK or GBIF_AUGMENTATION_EMPTY
Step 4: Verify no other status values are produced

description: slugify converts scientific names to species_key deterministically
steps: Step 1: Call slugify('Carcharodon carcharias')
Step 2: Assert result is 'carcharodon_carcharias'
Step 3: Verify output is lowercase with underscores
Step 4: Verify slugify('Prionace glauca') == 'prionace_glauca'

description: slugify handles multi-word scientific names correctly
steps: Step 1: Call slugify('Carcharodon carcharias')
Step 2: Assert result is 'carcharodon_carcharias'
Step 3: Verify no extra characters or spaces remain
Step 4: Verify all 18 seed species keys are producible via slugify

description: slugify handles None input gracefully
steps: Step 1: Call slugify(None)
Step 2: Assert result is empty string
Step 3: Verify no exception is raised
Step 4: Verify slugify('') == ''

description: Wikipedia resolution returns DIRECT_TITLE for exact title match
steps: Step 1: Call resolve_wikipedia_title('Great white shark')
Step 2: Verify status is SUCCESS
Step 3: Assert resolved_via == DIRECT_TITLE
Step 4: Verify title and page_url are populated

description: Wikipedia resolution follows redirects and returns REDIRECT
steps: Step 1: Call resolve_wikipedia_title with a known redirect title
Step 2: Verify function follows redirect
Step 3: Assert resolved_via == REDIRECT
Step 4: Verify final title is the canonical article title

description: Wikipedia resolution uses search fallback when direct title fails
steps: Step 1: Call resolve_wikipedia_title with a scientific name (not a title)
Step 2: Verify function searches Wikipedia API
Step 3: Assert resolved_via == SEARCH
Step 4: Verify returned page_url is valid

description: Wikipedia resolution returns PAGE_NOT_FOUND when no article exists
steps: Step 1: Call resolve_wikipedia_title with a nonexistent title
Step 2: Verify status is PAGE_NOT_FOUND
Step 3: Assert no title is returned
Step 4: Verify error is documented for quarantine

description: Wikipedia resolution detects disambiguation pages
steps: Step 1: Call resolve_wikipedia_title with a disambiguation page title
Step 2: Verify is_disambiguation flag is True
Step 3: Assert status is DISAMBIGUATION_PAGE
Step 4: Verify disambiguation page is rejected, not accepted

description: Wikipedia resolution detects ambiguous results and sets AMBIGUOUS_RESOLUTION
steps: Step 1: Call resolve_wikipedia_title with a name mapping to multiple candidates
Step 2: Verify status is AMBIGUOUS_RESOLUTION
Step 3: Assert no title is returned
Step 4: Verify candidates are logged for debugging

description: resolved_via only ever takes DIRECT_TITLE, SEARCH, or REDIRECT
steps: Step 1: Inspect ResolutionMethod enum
Step 2: Assert members are DIRECT_TITLE, SEARCH, REDIRECT
Step 3: Verify no other resolved_via values are emitted
Step 4: Verify silver.wikipedia_pages.resolved_via accepts only these

description: Wikipedia requests use retry with exponential backoff on 429
steps: Step 1: Inspect request helper in resolver
Step 2: Verify 429 responses trigger retry
Step 3: Verify backoff wait is 2**attempt
Step 4: Verify max_retries is bounded

description: Wikipedia requests include a User-Agent header
steps: Step 1: Inspect request helper headers
Step 2: Verify User-Agent header is present
Step 3: Verify header identifies the educational project
Step 4: Verify header is applied to all Wikipedia calls

description: GBIF Species Match endpoint is used for taxonomy ingestion

Step 2: Verify URL is https://api.gbif.org/v1/species/match
Step 3: Verify name parameter is passed
Step 4: Verify response is returned as raw dict

Step 2: Verify scientificName parameter
Step 3: Verify hasCoordinate=true
Step 4: Verify limit=50

description: Wikipedia summary endpoint is used via REST API

Step 2: Verify URL is https://en.wikipedia.org/api/rest_v1/page/summary/{title}
Step 3: Verify title spaces are replaced with underscores
Step 4: Verify response is returned as raw dict

description: Wikipedia full extracts endpoint uses action API with explaintext=true
steps: Step 1: Inspect bronze fetcher for extracts URL
Step 2: Verify action=query, prop=extracts, explaintext=true

Step 4: Verify format=json

Step 3: Verify run_id, batch_id, species_key, scientific_name STRING NOT NULL
Step 4: Verify raw_payload STRING NOT NULL and ingested_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL

steps: Step 1: Inspect gbif_taxonomy_raw schema
Step 2: Verify ingestion_id STRING NOT NULL
Step 3: Verify run_id, batch_id, species_key, scientific_name STRING NOT NULL
Step 4: Verify raw_payload STRING NOT NULL and ingested_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL

description: bronze.gbif_occurrence_raw has required fields ingestion_id, run_id, batch_id, species_key, scientific_name, raw_payload, ingested_at
steps: Step 1: Inspect gbif_occurrence_raw schema
Step 2: Verify ingestion_id STRING NOT NULL
Step 3: Verify run_id, batch_id, species_key, scientific_name STRING NOT NULL
Step 4: Verify raw_payload STRING NOT NULL and ingested_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL

description: Bronze ingestion_id is a unique identifier per raw row
steps: Step 1: Run bronze ingestion for a batch
Step 2: Query ingestion_id values
Step 3: Verify each row has a unique ingestion_id
Step 4: Verify ingestion_id is deterministic or UUID-based as designed

description: Bronze persists HTTP errors as data (errors are data)
steps: Step 1: Simulate an HTTP error from a source API
Step 2: Verify a bronze row is still written
Step 3: Assert raw_payload contains the error response
Step 4: Verify envelope metadata is still populated

description: Bronze persists empty responses as data
steps: Step 1: Fetch a source that returns an empty result
Step 2: Verify a bronze row is written
Step 3: Assert raw_payload contains the empty response
Step 4: Verify no transformation is applied

description: Bronze is reconstructable and audit-oriented
steps: Step 1: Run bronze ingestion for a batch
Step 2: Verify raw_payload can be deserialized back to the original response
Step 3: Verify run_id/batch_id allow tracing to a specific execution
Step 4: Verify no information is lost in Bronze

description: Bronze is not semantically validated
steps: Step 1: Inspect bronze write path
Step 2: Verify no Pydantic validation occurs in Bronze
Step 3: Verify no field-level parsing/coercion in Bronze
Step 4: Verify Silver owns semantic parsing and validation

description: Re-running the same logical batch appends new Bronze observations
steps: Step 1: Run bronze ingestion for a batch
Step 2: Record row count
Step 3: Re-run the same batch
Step 4: Verify row count increased (append-only audit trail)

description: Bronze raw_payload preserves the complete JSON envelope from the fetcher
steps: Step 1: Inspect fetcher return shape
Step 2: Verify fetcher returns {status, data} envelope
Step 3: Verify raw_payload stores the full envelope as JSON string

description: Bronze fetchers apply retry with exponential backoff on 429
steps: Step 1: Inspect bronze fetcher request helper
Step 2: Verify 429 triggers retry
Step 3: Verify backoff is exponential
Step 4: Verify retries are bounded

description: WikipediaPage Pydantic model validates species_key as string
steps: Step 1: Create WikipediaPage with valid species_key

description: WikipediaPage Pydantic model validates title as non-empty string
